gloss: to correct; to adjust; to calibrate

definitions.gloss: to correct; to adjust; to calibrate; to compensate for
definitions.explanation: To make fine adjustments or corrections to bring something to a more accurate or desired state. Used in technical, budgetary, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補正|ほせい}する。
⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補正|ほせい}する⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The budget needs to be revised.

examples.japanese: ⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}ぶれ→手ぶれ：20358_tebure⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自動的|じどうてき}→自動的：25589_jidouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{補正|ほせい}する⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: It has a function that automatically corrects camera shake.

notes:
Implies making corrections or adjustments to something that is slightly off from the ideal. Commonly used in photography/image editing, government budgets, statistics, and technical calibration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{補正|ほせい}{予算|よさん}→補正予算：15579_hoseiyosan⟧: supplementary budget; revised budget
- ⟦{手|て}ぶれ→手ぶれ：20358_tebure⟧⟦{補正|ほせい}→補正：18527_hosei⟧: image stabilization
- ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦{補正|ほせい}→補正：18527_hosei⟧: color correction
- ⟦{補正|ほせい}→補正：18527_hosei⟧{値|ち}: correction value; offset
- ⟦{補正|ほせい}→補正：18527_hosei⟧⟦{下着|したぎ}→下着：01605_shitagi⟧: shapewear (body-shaping underwear)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{修正|しゅうせい}する→修正する：25527_shuuseisuru⟧: to revise; to amend — broader; can mean rewriting or significantly changing
- ⟦{訂正|ていせい}する→訂正する：10443_teiseisuru⟧: to correct (errors) — specifically for fixing mistakes in text or statements
- ⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧: to adjust; to coordinate — more about bringing into alignment or balance
